violation_type.title: Requirements for Swings - Edges Smooth or Rounded with No Protrusions (26 TAC §747.4501(b))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Swings - Edges Smooth or Rounded with No Protrusions
violation_type.typical_finding: The material of the swing seat may not meet current requirements.

finding_variants.text: The material of the swing seat may not meet current requirements.
One of the bucket swings was cracked and splitting where the support chain held the swing.     This was corrected at inspection when the bucket swing was removed.
